basic_info.description: Located in a classic three-unit Edwardian building, this top-floor condo blends vintage charm with everyday comfort. Two spacious bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a versatile bonus room ideal for a home office or nursery.Tall ceilings, bay windows, hardwood floors, and a stained glass skylight fill the home with natural light. The open kitchen has been updated with a gas range, new stainless refrigerator and microwave. It is open to the dining area. A decorative fireplace adds a cozy touch to the living space. Enjoy views of Twin Peaks, Sutro Tower, and nearby Bernal Heights Park. The bathroom includes a clawfoot soaking tub with overhead shower. A sunny laundry area on the back porch features new washer and dryer units and has enough space for a breakfast nook or an additional workspace. Newly installed gas wall furnace, freshly painted unit, and roof replaced in June of 2025! The shared backyard patio is great for barbecues and gatherings. This location scores high for walkability and bike access. Entry area to unit is private and ideal for bike storage. You'll be close to tech shuttle routes, public transit, and key bike paths. Shopping and dining options in Noe Valley, the Mission, and Bernal Heights are all nearby. Juri Commons and Dolores Park are minutes away.
